headline: Prime angle, wrong everything else — onshore junk today.
today: The SSE swell is lined up at a prime angle but it's tiny and mostly short-period, and the wind is onshore-to-cross-on and building all day to 17mph. Nothing clean to chase. Sit this one out and save it for midweek.

daysToWatch.note: Best day of the stretch — chest-high (2.4-3.4ft) at a prime angle with light cross/cross-on winds under 6mph. Morning is the play before the afternoon onshore. Fish or groveler.
Drops to waist-to-chest but N offshore in the morning cleans it right up. Easy log or groveler on the early tide.
